finding.issue: Foreign profile links could reach Cargo before the per-case no-follow check.

Coverage/debug selection and symbols retain profile semantics. UNIX paths use short TMPDIR or project-root relative sockets, not the expanded target path.
limitations: Focused fixtures establish controller behavior, not kernel/OSDK integration passage.
No conclusion about the historical unknown writer. Arbitrary external processes are outside the cooperative lock contract.
The complete new-source 22-case real regression is still required and will be run by root.
decision: No remaining blocking issue found in the reviewed repair.
